parameters.content:
## BookLeaf royalty summary
POST /webhook/royalty-summary with header X-BookLeaf-Key (n8n Header Auth: a missing or wrong key gets 403 before the workflow starts). Server settings come from the bookleaf_settings table (Load Settings, then Check Settings).
**Enqueue Job** calls enqueue_royalty_job, which makes the job id: a double click gets the first job back (200, duplicate), more than max_sends_per_hour gets 429, anything else 202 {job_id} at once. Then the **Write Draft** sub-workflow writes and fact-checks the email (Anthropic, OpenAI if it fails); **Rewrite Draft** runs it once more with the checker's notes. **Deliver Email** sends it and records SENT or EMAIL_FAILED. A draft (delivery=draft) and every failure end in **Record Result**. Code nodes are generated from n8n/src by n8n/build.mjs.

## Intake
The settings are checked (bad settings: 500), then the body (a bad body: 400). Database down before the answer: 503.

## Ledger
One locked call: a new job (202), a double click (200, the same job) or the hourly cap (429).

## Data & facts
Figures checked, facts and prompt built.

## AI writer
Sub-workflow: Anthropic, OpenAI if it fails, then the fact check.

## Fact check
Pass, one rewrite with the checker's notes, or fail.

## Render & deliver
HTML and text email; Deliver Email sends it once.

## Record
Drafts and every failure end here.

parameters.query: SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) AS settings FROM bookleaf_settings
SELECT outcome, job_id, status, error_code FROM enqueue_royalty_job($1::jsonb)

parameters.responseBody: ={{ Object.assign({ job_id: $json.job_id, status: $json.status, duplicate: true }, $json.error_code ? { error_code: $json.error_code } : {}) }}
{"error":{"code":"INTERNAL","message":"An unexpected error stopped the workflow. The enqueue gave an unexpected answer.","retryable":true}}
{"error":{"code":"DB_UNAVAILABLE","message":"The job database could not be reached, so the request was not handled. Try again shortly.","retryable":true}}

parameters.query:
UPDATE royalty_jobs SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = 'writing', stage_at = now(), updated_at = now()
WHERE job_id = ($1::jsonb->>'job_id')::uuid AND status = 'QUEUED'
RETURNING job_id::text AS job_id, status

UPDATE royalty_jobs SET stage = $1::jsonb->>'stage', stage_at = now(), updated_at = now()
WHERE job_id = ($1::jsonb->>'job_id')::uuid AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')
RETURNING job_id::text AS job_id, stage

parameters.errorMessage: Write Draft gave an unexpected outcome.

parameters.query:
UPDATE royalty_jobs AS j SET
  status = COALESCE(p.status, j.status),
  stage = COALESCE(p.stage, CASE p.status WHEN 'SENT' THEN 'sent' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 'failed' WHEN 'DRAFTED' THEN 'drafted' END, j.stage),
  stage_at = CASE WHEN p.stage IS NOT NULL OR p.status IS NOT NULL THEN now() ELSE j.stage_at END,
  error_code = COALESCE(p.error_code, j.error_code),
  error = COALESCE(p.error, j.error),
  author_code = COALESCE(p.author_code, j.author_code),
  subject = COALESCE(p.subject, j.subject),
  html = COALESCE(p.html, j.html),
  text_body = COALESCE(p.text_body, j.text_body),
  sent_to = COALESCE(p.sent_to, j.sent_to),
  figures_verified = COALESCE(p.figures_verified, j.figures_verified),
  ai_attempts = COALESCE(p.ai_attempts, j.ai_attempts),
  provider = COALESCE(p.provider, j.provider),
  model = COALESCE(p.model, j.model),
  input_tokens = COALESCE(p.input_tokens, j.input_tokens),
  output_tokens = COALESCE(p.output_tokens, j.output_tokens),
  cost_usd = COALESCE(p.cost_usd, j.cost_usd),
  sections = COALESCE(p.sections, j.sections),
  facts = COALESCE(p.facts, j.facts),
  titles = COALESCE(p.titles, j.titles),
  edit_text = COALESCE(p.edit_text, j.edit_text),
  issues = COALESCE(p.issues, j.issues),
  drafted_at = CASE WHEN p.status = 'DRAFTED' THEN now() ELSE j.drafted_at END,
  completed_at = CASE WHEN p.status IN ('SENT', 'FAILED') THEN now() ELSE j.completed_at END,
  updated_at = now()
FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS p(
  job_id uuid, status text, stage text, error_code text, error text, author_code text, subject text, html text, text_body text,
  sent_to text, figures_verified int, ai_attempts int, provider text, model text, input_tokens int, output_tokens int,
  cost_usd numeric, sections jsonb, facts jsonb, titles jsonb, edit_text text, issues text)
WHERE j.job_id = p.job_id AND j.status IN ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')
RETURNING j.job_id::text AS job_id, j.status, j.stage, j.error_code
